__broaden__.αὐτόφιν: αὐτός — self, it; epic form with the suffix -φιν, standing for a genitive, sg. or pl. (= Attic αὐτοῦ, αὐτῶν), as after ἀπό: ’from it, from them’ · also with ἐπ’, a φιν-form of place: ’on the spot, in place’ (ἐπ’ αὐτόφιν ’on the spot’)
__broaden__.ἄν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency; with the subj. = future contingency, ’perhaps, may’ · also with the opt., potential: ’would, could’ (οὐκ ἄν τι φέροις ’you could not carry off anything’) · also ὅτ’ ἄν + subj., ’whenever’ (= ὅταν) · also ἀνά with apocope (ἄν τε μάχην = ἀνά τε μάχην): ’up, through’ + acc. · also with the impf. indic., past potential: ’would have’ (οὐδ’ ἄν πω χάζοντο ’would not yet have been giving ground’) · also with the aor. indic. in the main clause of a past unreal condition: ’would have’ (οὐδ’ ἄν … ἐρρήξαντο … εἰ μὴ … ὦρσεν) · also ὡς ἄν + opt., purpose: ’so that … might’ (ὡς ἄν … ἐξαγάγοις ’so that you might bring out’)
__broaden__.μὴ: μή — not; negative in wishes, prohibitions and purpose clauses (’lest, that not’) · also in a conditional clause + subj.: ’if not’ · also in a conditional clause + opt.: εἰ μὴ … μνησαίαθ’ ’unless … were to call to mind’ · also εἰ μὴ with an aor. indic., past unreal condition: ’had not’ (εἰ μὴ … ἐξήγγειλεν ’had not … told’) · also μὴ μέν + fut. indic., introducing the content of an oath: ’that … not’ (μὴ μὲν … ἐποχήσεται ’that no other man will ride’) · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’) · also the negative of an infinitive in a reported threat: ’not to’ (μὴ πρίν … ἀπονέεσθαι ’not to go back until’) · also μή + pres. indic. after an oath, introducing its content: ’that … not’ (μὴ … πημαίνει ’that he does not harm’) · also the negative of an infinitive used as a command: ’and not to’ (μὴ δὲ … εἶναι ’and do not be’) · also μὴ μέν + aor. indic., introducing the content of an oath: ’that … never’ (μὴ μὲν … χεῖρ’ ἐπένεικα ’that I never laid a hand’)
__broaden__.ἐπίορκον: ἐπίορκος — false to one’s oath; adj. of two endings, neut. acc. sg., as cognate object of ὄμνυμι: ’a false (oath)’ · also neut. nom. sg., predicate of a conditional clause: ’a false oath’ (εἴ τι τῶνδ’ ἐπίορκον ’if any of this is a false oath’)
__broaden__.ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’) · also prep. + acc. after ἀλύξας, of escape: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ κῆρας ἀλύξας ’escaping the death-fates’) · also prep. + dat. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Τρώεσσι δαμῆναι ’to be overcome by the Trojans’) · also prep. + φι-form of cause: ’under, by’ (ὑπὸ Πηλεΐδαο βίηφιν ’by the might of Peleus’ son’) · also prep. + acc., of time or condition throughout: ’under’ (ὑπὸ μηνιθμόν ’all the while under the wrath’) · also prep. + gen. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Πατρόκλοιο δαμῆναι ’to be subdued by Patroclus’) · also prep. + acc., place where: ’beneath’ (ὑπὸ γαῖαν ’beneath the earth’)
__broaden__.κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, along; + acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἔκηα ’burned up’) · also + acc. in κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’ · also + acc. of purpose, ’for’ (κατὰ δαῖτα ’for a feast’) · also + acc. of respect, ’in’ (κατὰ θυμόν ’in heart’) · also + acc., distributive: ’by’ (κατὰ φῦλα ’by tribes’) · also + acc. of place: ’in, among’ (κατὰ ὑσμίνας ’in the battles’) · also κατὰ σφέας ’by themselves, apart’ · also + acc. of the place struck: ’in, on’ (κατὰ δεξιὸν ὦμον ’in the right shoulder’) · also + acc., ’into, toward’ (κατὰ πληθὺν ’toward the throng’) · also + acc., ’according to, after’ (κατὰ θυμόν ’after one’s heart’) · also κατὰ ἶσα ’equally, evenly’ (κατὰ ἶσα μάχην ἐτάνυσσε) · also + acc. of the part of a weapon: ’at’ (κατὰ στόμα ’at the tip’) · also + acc., ’through, out along’ (κατὰ ῥῖνας ’out through the nostrils’) · also + gen., ’down into’ (κατὰ γαίης ’down into the earth’) · also κατὰ πάμπαν, adverbial: ’altogether, utterly’
__broaden__.σίτοιο: σῖτος — food, bread; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), dependent on a noun of giving: ’of food’ · also masc. gen. sg., gen. of lack with ἄκμηνος: ’without food’ · also masc. gen. sg., object of ἄσασθαι: ’(satisfy oneself) with food’
__broaden__.ποτῆτος: ποτής — drink, drinking (= Attic πόσις); fem. gen. sg., after τάρπημεν: ’of drink’ · also fem. gen. sg., object of ἄσασθαι: ’(satisfy oneself) with drink’
__broaden__.πόσιος: πόσις — drinking, drink; fem. gen. sg. (distinct from πόσις ’husband’), after ἔρον: ’desire for drink’ · also fem. gen. sg., object of a verb of remembering: ’of drink’ (μεμνῆσθαι πόσιος) · also fem. gen. sg., gen. of lack with ἄκμηνος: ’without drink’
__broaden__.ἐδητύος: ἐδητύς — eating, food; fem. gen. sg., after ἔρον: ’desire for food’ · also fem. gen. sg., object of a verb of remembering: ’of food’ (μεμνῆσθαι … ἐδητύος) · also fem. gen. sg., gen. of lack with ἄκμηνος: ’without food’
__broaden__.ἀποφθιμένοιο: ἀποφθίνω — perish, die; aor. part. mid. masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), agreeing with παιδός: ’who has perished’ · also aor. part. mid. masc. gen. sg., agreeing with πατρός: ’of my father dead’ (πατρὸς ἀποφθιμένοιο) · also aor. part. mid. masc. gen. sg., ’me’ understood, with πύθηται: ’of me, once dead’
__broaden__.πολέμου: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. gen. sg., after ἀποπαύεο: ’from war’ · also gen. sg. of separation after ἐκ: ’out of the war’ · also masc. gen. sg., after ἄτερ: ’without war’ · also masc. gen. sg., after εἶκε: ’from war’ (εἶκε … πολέμου ’withdraw from war’) · also masc. gen. sg. of separation after ἀφεξόμεθ’: ’from war’ · also masc. gen. sg., after ἔραται: ’for war’ (πολέμου ἔραται ’loves war’) · also masc. gen. sg., gen. of respect after ἀκορήτω: ’insatiate of war’ · also masc. gen. sg. after ἤ, dependent on ἔρον: ’than (desire) for war’ · also masc. gen. sg., dependent on ἐρωή: ’(respite) from war’ · also masc. gen. sg., dependent on τέλος: ’of war’ (τέλος πολέμου ’the outcome of war’) · also masc. gen. sg., dependent on ὀαριστύς: ’of war’ · also masc. gen. sg., dependent on στόμα: ’of war’ (πολέμου στόμα ’the mouth of war’)
__broaden__.ἀτρεΐδα: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus; masc. acc. dual: ’the two sons of Atreus’ · also masc. nom. dual, subject of μενέτην: ’the two sons of Atreus’
